cohort: A 26-year-old primigravida at 24 weeks gestation presented with a large adrenal cyst (20x13x12 cm) diagnosed during pregnancy.
finding: Conservative management of a large adrenal cyst in pregnancy, including aspiration to reduce cyst volume, can lead to an uneventful antenatal course and term delivery, with definitive surgical removal performed postpartum.
gest_age: 24 weeks at referral, delivered at term
